mapper.select: SELECT id FROM coupon_reward_record WHERE reward_status='pending' AND next_retry_at<=#{now} ORDER BY next_retry_at, id LIMIT 100

SELECT r.id, r.user_id, u.user_status, r.event_type, rr.template_id, r.reward_status, t.template_status, t.validity_type, t.valid_days, t.valid_start_at, t.valid_end_at FROM coupon_reward_record r JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=r.user_id JOIN coupon_reward_rule rr ON rr.id=r.rule_id JOIN coupon_template t ON t.id=rr.template_id WHERE r.id=#{id}
SELECT id FROM coupon_template WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT reward_status FROM coupon_reward_record WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_coupon(id, user_coupon_no, template_id, user_id, issue_source_type, issue_source_id, issue_request_id, coupon_status, coupon_type_snapshot, face_amount_fen_snapshot, discount_rate_bps_snapshot, threshold_rent_amount_fen_snapshot, cost_bearer_snapshot, valid_from, valid_until, created_at, updated_at) SELECT #{id}, #{id}, id, #{reward.userId}, 'event_reward', #{reward.id}, CONCAT('reward:', #{reward.id}), 'available', coupon_type, face_amount_fen, discount_rate_bps, threshold_rent_amount_fen, cost_bearer, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{now}, #{now} FROM coupon_template WHERE id=#{reward.templateId}

INSERT INTO coupon_operation_log(id, operation_request_id, user_coupon_id, operation_type, to_status, operator_type, operator_id, biz_type, biz_id, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, CONCAT('reward:', #{rewardId}), #{couponId}, 'issued', 'available', 'system', #{operator}, 'reward_record', #{rewardId}, #{reason}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE coupon_reward_record SET reward_status='granted', granted_at=#{now}, attempt_count=attempt_count+1, next_retry_at=NULL, last_error_code=NULL, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND reward_status='pending'

UPDATE coupon_reward_record SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1, next_retry_at=DATE_ADD(#{now}, INTERVAL 5 MINUTE), last_error_code=#{reason}, updated_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND reward_status='pending'
